title: 2048 Classic
description: Join the numbered tiles and reach the 2048 block in this addictive sliding puzzle.
controls: Arrow Keys or Swipe to slide tiles

title: Tetris Arcade
description: The timeless falling blocks puzzle. Clear lines, perform wall kicks, and beat your high score.
controls: Arrows to move/rotate, Space for hard drop, C to hold piece

title: Snake Classic
description: Guide the hungry retro neon serpent to gobble food and avoid hitting walls or your tail.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to turn, Space to pause

title: Flappy Falcon
description: Flap through endless hazardous pipes with precise timing and physics-based navigation.
controls: Spacebar, Click, or Tap to flap

title: Space Invaders Retro
description: Defend the planet against waves of descending alien invaders with your laser battery.
controls: Left/Right Arrows or A/D to steer, Space to fire lasers

title: Brick Breaker DX
description: Smash tiers of colored bricks with paddle deflection angles and bouncing ball mechanics.
controls: Mouse, Touch, or Left/Right Arrows, Space to launch

title: Dino T-Rex Runner
description: Infinite desert obstacle runner. Jump cacti, duck under pterodactyls, and survive the heat.
controls: Space/Up Arrow to jump, Down Arrow to duck

title: Retro Pong Masters
description: Classic 1972 table tennis duel. Play against smart CPU AI or challenge a friend in 2-player mode.
controls: P1: W/S or Arrows · P2: Up/Down Arrows

title: Minesweeper Pro
description: Classic strategic logic game. Flag dangerous hidden mines and clear safe minefields.
controls: Left click reveal, Right click or Flag Mode button to place flags

title: Pac-Runner Arcade
description: Munch all yellow pellets through winding neon labyrinths while outsmarting roaming ghosts.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to navigate
